notes.title: Rival Rides New Update!
notes.content:
[h2]We're excited to announce our latest update for Rival Rides, filled with exciting new features and enhancements to take your Rival Rides experience to the next level![/h2]

[b]News Board:[/b] We've added a board that will be updated daily with the latest on events, stories, updates, and more!

[b]Ride Bucks Collection:[/b] You can now earn Ride Bucks simply by playing the game! The higher your score, the greater the reward!

[b]Kick System: [/b]Players now have the ability to collectively vote to kick someone from their lobby.

[b]Voting System:[/b] You can now view which players have accepted or declined to start a game.

[b]Closed Lobby:[/b] As a lobby owner, you now have the option to close your lobby to the public and reopen it at your discretion.
[b]
Score Abuse System:[/b] We've revised the score calculation to prevent abuse of the leaderboard and to ensure fair distribution of rewards post-game.
[b]
Level Representation:[/b] Your level is now visibly displayed next to your nickname, showcasing your achievements to fellow players.

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]We've also been hard at work fixing pesky bugs for a smoother gaming experience.

notes.title: Rival Rides is Now Free-to-Play!
notes.content:
[h3][b]New Game Mode:[/b] Area of Fame is our new game mode, fight in a deathmatch or Capture the Egg!

[b]Expanded Lobbies:[/b] Now supporting up to 6 players for even bigger fun!

[b]AI-Generated Skins:[/b] Create your own unique skin with the AI-generated feature. Just enter a prompt and watch the magic unfold!

[b]Spectator Mode:[/b] Watch and learn as the action unfolds with our new spectator feature.

[b]Green Screen Magic:[/b] Unleash your creativity with our green screen feature for epic videos!

[b]Lightning-Fast Loading:[/b] Experience significantly improved loading times for seamless gameplay.

[u]Bug Fixes:[/u] We've also been hard at work fixing pesky bugs for a smoother gaming experience.[/h3]

[h3]There are many more updates and improvements waiting for you![/h3]

notes.title: Rival Rides Update: Park Evolution
notes.content:
🎁 [b]Daily Rewards[/b]: Don't miss out on fantastic rewards! Log in daily to claim your well-deserved prizes. 

🪞 [b]Mirror Feature[/b]: Capture stunning moments with the new Mirror feature! Create a mirrored version of yourself and record amazing footage to share with your friends. 

🛠️ [b]Stability Improvements[/b]: Enjoy a smoother and glitch-free gameplay experience. We've worked hard to optimize the game for maximum enjoyment! 

📖 [b]Improved Hints for New Players[/b]: New to Rival Rides? No worries! Our improved hints system will guide you through every mechanic, making it a breeze to master the rides. 

🔢 [b]Place System[/b]: Stay informed about your position in the race! The game will now notify you about your current standing, so you don't have to look at your watch every time. 

🧞‍♂️ [b]Hauntedland[/b]: Unlock the power of the Genie Lamp with any weapon! Your wish for magical battles has been granted! 

🏅 [b]Badges[/b]: Discover official badges that distinguish developers, founders, moderators, content creators, and even the crowned King of Bloops! Wear your badge with pride! 

🌌[b]Cosmicland[/b]: Now, shooting the grenades will trigger explosive reactions! Prepare for an intensified cosmic experience! And now, we've also added headshots to amp up the excitement! 

🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]: We've been busy squashing pesky bugs to ensure a seamless and fun-filled adventure for all our players. 

⚙️ [b]Loading Screens[/b]: We temporarily disabled our loading screens as they were causing some bugs. Rest assured, we are actively working on resolving this. Thank you for your patience! 

👀 [b]Secret[/b]: Something new has popped up in the Rival Rides lobby. Search for it, explore it, and wonder what it could be! To be continued... 

There are many more updates and improvements waiting for you! 

Update your game now to experience the thrill of Rival Rides!

notes.title: RIVAL RIDES CONTENT UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]Thrilled to announce some exciting updates to Rival Rides! We've been working hard behind the scenes to deliver a more immersive and engaging experience for our players. [/h2]
[h3]Here's what's new:[/h3]

[b]Emotes[/b]: Express yourself better with our new set of Emotes! Flaunt your victories or shrug off a defeat in style.

[b]Drawing Board:[/b] Get creative and leave your mark in the park with our interactive Drawing Board.

[b]Drums[/b]: Fancy some music? Jump in and create your own rhythm with our new drum set.

[b]Climbing[/b]: Elevate your exploration with the new climbing feature. Reach new heights and discover hidden gems!

[b]Leaderboard[/b]: Track your progress and compete against friends with our newly implemented Leaderboard. Can you reach the top?

[b]New UI[/b]: We’ve revamped our user interface for a sleeker, more intuitive gaming experience.

[b]Leveling System[/b]: Earn XP, level up, and unlock new amazing items.

[b]Mouth Animation[/b]: We’ve added more life to our characters with realistic mouth animations. Communication just got more fun!

[b]Expanded Lobby[/b]: More space, more fun! Enjoy our expanded lobby area with new activities to engage in.

[b]Lobby Objects[/b]: Interact with new objects within the lobby for more fun and entertainment.

[b]Optimizations[/b]: We’ve smoothed out the bumps for a more seamless and efficient gaming experience.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]: Squashed some pesky bugs to make your Rival Rides experience better than ever.

Stay tuned for more updates and continue sharing your feedback - we're listening! Let the fun rides continue! 🚀🎢🎉
